checks.detail: frame_rate 30000, 12-bit saturation 4095 DL, threshold 100 DL on 27 datasets
between-speed pitch spread 0.0013 (limit 0.025, README speed uncertainty k=1)

max |extent - 10 mm| = 0.401 mm over 21 lines (tolerance 0.5 mm); reference: data/benchmark/nist-amb2022-03-optical/table4-aggregate-v2.json experiment.trackLength_mm (repo transcription citing AMB2022-03 Measurement and Challenge Descriptions v1.01)
7 cases, repeats per case [3]; none dropped
tracks {'Xpad': 47, 'Ypad': 24}; implied speed within 2.5 % of 960 mm/s: True; galvo/laser calibration applied flags 'false': True
pad camera analysis not run in v1 (see unavailable list)
no DL-to-temperature conversion is implemented in this module

conventions.axisMapping: Line hot spots move along camera axis a1 at a speed proportional to the commanded scan speed; a1 is taken as the line scan direction (derived-inferred).
conventions.beamDiameter: spot_size attribute, measure 'D4s' as stored by NIST
conventions.laserOnFrame: first frame containing a saturated pixel (operational definition)

evidence.evidenceKindMeasuredFor: NIST experiment only (raw camera signal, DL)
evidence.temperatureConversionMissingReason: No temperature conversion executed: the stored /Calibration/ThermalCal Model string has unbalanced parentheses and an unspecified emissivity e, its Celsius/Kelvin convention is not determinable from the file, and the melt-pool region is saturated at 4095 DL. A reviewed equation, a cited emissivity and the valid calibration range are required.

headline: Comparison, not validation: raw camera signal in digital levels (DL); no temperature conversion executed; derived values are signal-unit metrics for NIST's experiment only; nothing tuned.
